observed: FCB=0x000f0002; over 100 patterns, immediate_errors=0, foreign_write_errors=0, foreign_alias_errors=0 and overwrite_errors=0. Writes to aligned offsets +4, +8 and +c did not change the held 16-bit word at +0; subsequent valid +0 writes still overwrote it. foreign_alias_errors=0 means reads at +4/+8/+c intentionally returned the same +0 state. GPIO reset reported reset_initial=0000, reset_asserted=0000 and reset_blocked=0000.
implementation: A deterministic composition of the silicon-qualified one-wait external-feedback route adds exact HADDR2/HADDR3 inputs at MCU_DIN76/77 and an X14Y12_SLICE0 combinational gate on the qualified HWRITE path. The sixteen state cells, external feedback, wait controller, HWDATA inputs and HRDATA[15:0] exits are retained. The promoted routed JSON differs from the silicon-tested routed JSON only in its creator provenance string and emits the same bitstream.
controls: Each pattern writes +0, attempts three distinct foreign writes at +4/+8/+c, verifies +0 retention, verifies that all three foreign reads still alias +0, then performs and verifies a second valid +0 overwrite. Reset blocks writes at all four offsets.
scope: Qualifies write-commit isolation of the exact held 16-bit word at +0 against aligned offsets +4/+8/+c using HADDR[3:2], one inserted wait and GPIO reset on one L48 device. It does not qualify read address decoding (foreign reads alias +0), HADDR[1:0], byte or halfword writes, HSIZE composition, HRDATA[31:16], bursts, arbitrary placement/width, public ID/counter/W1C integration or a general register-bank generator.
consequence: The held 16-bit checkpoint now has bounded write-side word-offset isolation. Full address isolation remains open because reads deliberately alias, and subword semantics remain open.
next_experiment: Compose the qualified HSIZE1 corridor with HSIZE0 and HADDR[1:0] into a waited two-lane low/high byte-token oracle before widening the retained 16-bit state.

observed: Four complete 100-pattern runs each reported FCB=0x000f0002 and word_errors=0, low_byte_errors=0, high_byte_errors=0, upper_byte_mutations=0, foreign_mutations=0, overwrite_errors=0, reset_initial=0000, reset_asserted=0000 and reset_released=0000. A retained 16-bit word control then passed 100/100 with no retention/reset regression.
implementation: The exact held-16-bit checkpoint uses independent low/high pending tokens. The high selector is !HADDR1 && (HSIZE1 || HADDR0), buffered through a six-pip physical corridor; the handshake stage additionally requires the qualified HWRITE-word0 gate, write_ready_f and !reset. A replacement six-pip all-physical hwrite_word0 tail removed two inferred relative selectors that a sticky hardware probe showed were carrying the wrong signal. HREADY is reset || (!pending_low && !pending_high), giving either byte lane one qualified wait. Strict pack reports 467 data pips, 352 block-clean, 24 relative-clean, zero legacy-absolute, predicted or unmapped selectors.
controls: A forced-zero high-token image produced sticky mask 0x000 in 64 trials per transfer class. The all-physical HWRITE-route identity produced exactly 0x03f: word/halfword/byte writes inside word zero asserted, aligned writes +4/+8/+c did not. The buffered selector identity then fed the normal handshake/data capture. The promoted JSON changes only the non-emitted creator string from the file loaded on silicon and emits the same bitstream.
scope: Qualifies one exact L48 16-bit held-scratch composition for aligned 32-bit word writes at +0, independent 8-bit writes at byte offsets +0 and +1, rejection of byte offsets +2/+3, rejection of aligned writes +4/+8/+c, overwrite/hold/readback, one wait, and GPIO4.1 synchronous reset. Reads at foreign offsets still alias +0. Halfword transfers were deliberately not tested; HSIZE0, HRDATA[31:16], bursts, arbitrary placement/width, a generic bank generator, and integration with the public ID/counter/W1C bank remain unqualified.
consequence: The exact 16-bit checkpoint now has silicon-qualified word and low/high byte storage semantics plus write-offset isolation. Halfword and read-address decoding remain the next protocol gaps; this is not a generic 16-bit register-bank claim.
next_experiment: Add a separately observed HSIZE0 corridor and halfword oracle, then compose read-address decoding before any public-bank widening.
